# 全局设置
# Global Settings for Universal Checklist Enforcer

settings:
  # 基本配置
  app_name: "Universal Checklist Enforcer"
  version: "1.2.0"
  author: "OpenClaw"
  
  # 日志配置
  logging:
    level: INFO  # DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR
    format: "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
    log_dir: "memory/checklist_logs"
    max_days: 90  # 日志保留天数
    
  # 报告配置
  report:
    default_days: 7
    max_days: 365
    include_details: true
    include_recommendations: true
    
  # 执行配置
